Name: A1_Welcome
Subject: Welcome back, {EMP}!
Body:
Good morning, {EMP}!

We hope you slept well. Today is a big day, and we're so glad you're here for it.

Your task list is on your badge. Please complete Mandatory Compliance Training before noon.

Remember: you are exactly where you need to be.

Warmly,
The People Team

Name: A1_ChairmanMemo
Subject: Places, everyone.
Body:
Team,

Big day. Everyone knows their marks.

Let's keep it natural. Let's keep it moving. And let's get it in one take this time.

- C

Name: A1_SecurityIncident
Subject: INCIDENT REPORT #4471-B
Body:
Employee {EMP},

At approximately now, you threw an object at a member of Security.
This has been noted. It has been noted before.
Security does not forget. Security does not need to.

Further incidents will be escalated to HR.

- Officer on duty (the one you hit)

Name: A1_HRIncident
Subject: A gentle reminder about workplace conduct :)
Body:
Hi {EMP}!

We've received several reports of office supplies travelling at speed.
At HALCYON, every object has its place, and so does every employee.

Please complete Respectful Workplace Module 2 at your earliest convenience.
(There is no Module 2. Please stop.)

Warmly,
People Team
